Author bio: Full time CEO @t3dotchat. Part time YouTuber, investor, and developer
Text: Wanted to make it easier for T3 Code users to debug their setups when things go wrong. Just shipped a new feature on nightly to help.

`npx t3@nightly triage`

It collects info on your setup, writes a prompt, then kicks you to Claude Code or Codex to debug and fix https://t.co/k4mbLCFXWP
